vnstat_interface.description: Default interface name to monitor. Leave empty for automatic selection.

vnstat_database_dir.description: Location of the vnStat database directory.

vnstat_locale.description: Locale to use (LC_ALL). Use '-' for system locale.

vnstat_rate_unit_mode.description: Rate unit prefix mode for bits: 0=IEC, 1=SI.

vnstat_output_style.description: Output style: 0=minimal, 1=bar visible, 2=bar+summary rate, 3=rate column visible.

vnstat_estimate_bar_visible.description: Whether the estimate bar is visible.

vnstat_default_decimals.description: Number of decimals for default outputs.

vnstat_hourly_decimals.description: Number of decimals for hourly outputs.

vnstat_sampletime.description: Sampling time in seconds for -tr option.

vnstat_interface_match_method.description: Interface matching method: 0=case-sensitive exact, 1=alias exact, 2=alias case-insensitive exact, 3=alias case-insensitive begin.

vnstat_daemon_user.description: User to switch to when vnstatd runs as root. Empty to disable.

vnstat_daemon_group.description: Group to switch to when vnstatd runs as root. Empty to disable.

vnstat_max_bandwidth.description: Maximum bandwidth in Mbit for all interfaces (0=disable).

vnstat_5_minute_hours.description: Retention duration for 5-minute data in hours (-1=unlimited).

vnstat_hourly_days.description: Retention duration for hourly data in days (0=disabled).

vnstat_daily_days.description: Retention duration for daily data in days (0=disabled).

vnstat_monthly_months.description: Retention duration for monthly data in months (0=disabled).

vnstat_yearly_years.description: Retention duration for yearly data in years (-1=unlimited).

vnstat_top_day_entries.description: Number of top day entries to keep.

vnstat_update_interval.description: Interval in seconds to update interface data.

vnstat_poll_interval.description: Interval in seconds to check for interface status changes.

vnstat_save_interval.description: Interval in minutes to save data to database.

vnstat_offline_save_interval.description: Interval in minutes to save data when all interfaces are offline.

vnstat_rescan_database_on_save.description: Rescan database for new interfaces after saving (1=enabled).

vnstat_always_add_new_interfaces.description: Automatically add new interfaces not in database (1=enabled).

vnstat_month_rotate.description: Day of the month when months change (1-31).

vnstat_month_rotate_affects_years.description: Whether month rotation affects yearly data (1=enabled).

vnstat_boot_variation.description: Allowed boot time variation in seconds between updates.

vnstat_trafficless_entries.description: Create database entries for interfaces with no traffic (1=enabled).

vnstat_time_sync_wait.description: Minutes to wait for system clock sync during startup if time is in future.

vnstat_bandwidth_detection_interval.description: Interval in minutes for bandwidth detection (0=disabled).

vnstat_save_on_status_change.description: Force data save on interface status change (1=enabled).

vnstat_create_dirs.description: Create necessary directories if they don't exist (1=enabled).

vnstat_log_file.description: Path to the log file if UseLogging is 1.

vnstat_pid_file.description: Path to the daemon PID/lock file.

vnstat_hourly_rate.description: Show rates with hours in vnstati (1=enabled).

vnstat_summary_rate.description: Show rate in summary in vnstati (1=enabled).

vnstat_transparent_bg.description: Use transparent background in vnstati images (1=enabled).

vnstat_large_fonts.description: Use large fonts in vnstati images (1=enabled).

vnstat_line_spacing_adjustment.description: Adjust line spacing in vnstati images.

vnstat_hourly_graph_mode.description: Hourly graph mode: 0=24h sliding window, 1=from midnight.

vnstat_bar_column_shows_rate.description: Show rate in bar column if OutputStyle is 3 (1=enabled).

vnstat_cbackground.description: Background color hex code for vnstati.

vnstat_cedge.description: Edge color hex code for vnstati.

vnstat_cheader.description: Header background color hex code for vnstati.

vnstat_cheader_title.description: Header title text color hex code for vnstati.

vnstat_cheader_date.description: Header date text color hex code for vnstati.

vnstat_ctext.description: Main text color hex code for vnstati.

vnstat_cline.description: Line color hex code for vnstati.

vnstat_cline_l.description: Light line color hex code for vnstati.

vnstat_crx.description: RX traffic color hex code for vnstati.

vnstat_ctx.description: TX traffic color hex code for vnstati.

vnstat_crxd.description: RX dotted line color hex code for vnstati.

vnstat_ctxd.description: TX dotted line color hex code for vnstati.
